title: Northbeam TechWorks Circle Programme Liaison: The Share of Labour and Surcharge Relieved
content:
The share taken into a membership relief on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job turns on whether the work was rework and, failing that, on the standing and tier of the customer's Northbeam Circle Membership.

## The rule

Where the attendance was a rework of work already signed off and the job itself was raised as a rework, one hundred percent of the labour figure and the surcharge figure is taken into the relief; where a Circle membership stands active on the profile and its tier carries a repair labour discount, that tier's repair labour discount percent is taken into the relief instead. Where neither situation holds, nothing of that labour is taken into the relief.

## The two conditions, read part by part

The rework situation is a compound one, and both parts of it must hold: a rework entry must stand on the job, showing the attendance was a rework of work already signed off, **and** the job's own work type must be rework. The membership situation is compound too: a Circle membership must stand active on the profile, **and** the tier it stands on must carry a repair labour discount, that is, a discount percent above nothing.

| Rework entry standing and the job raised as a rework | Circle membership active with a tier carrying a repair labour discount | The share |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | either | one hundred percent |
| no | yes | the membership tier's repair labour discount percent |
| no | no | nothing |

The rework situation is read first: where it holds, the share is one hundred percent whatever the standing of the membership.

The repair labour discount percent of each Circle tier is a figure of Northbeam Circle Membership, read from the tier the membership stands on.

## Illustrations on hypothetical jobs

*The amounts and the tier below are chosen for the illustration and are not figures of any job or membership on file.*

**An ordinary repair, no membership standing active.** The job was not raised as a rework and no Circle membership stands active on the profile. Neither situation holds and the share is nothing, so nothing of that labour is taken into the relief.

**An ordinary repair for an active member.** The customer's Circle membership stands active on Circle Plus Annual, a tier carrying a repair labour discount of 10 percent. The share is 10 percent, so on a labour figure of 186.60 USD and a surcharge figure of 52.80 USD — 239.40 USD added together — 239.40 multiplied by 10 and divided by one hundred gives 23.94 USD.

**A rework job.** The job was raised as a rework and carries a rework entry against work already signed off. The share is one hundred percent: on the same figures, the whole of the 239.40 USD is taken into the relief.
